mapper.select: select count(*) as allBoardCnt, sum(case when category_idx = 'NOTICE' then 1 else 0 end) as noticeBoardCnt, sum(case when category_idx = 'FREE' then 1 else 0 end) as freeBoardCnt, sum(case when category_idx = 'QNA' then 1 else 0 end) as qnaBoardCnt, sum(case when category_idx = 'INFO' then 1 else 0 end) as infoBoardCnt, sum(case when category_idx = 'REPORT' then 1 else 0 end) as reportBoardCnt from board
mapper.insert: insert into board (member_id, board_title, board_content, category_idx, notice_yn) values (#{memberId}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{categoryIdx}, #{noticeYn})
mapper.select: select b.board_id, b.member_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.category_idx, b.view_count, b.reg_date, b.mod_date, COALESCE(m.member_name, '알 수 없음') as member_name from board b left join member m on b.member_id = m.member_id where b.board_id = #{boardId}

select b.board_id, b.member_id, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.category_idx, b.view_count, b.notice_yn, b.reg_date, b.mod_date, COALESCE(m.member_name, '알 수 없음') as member_name from board b left join member m on b.member_id = m.member_id order by b.reg_date desc
mapper.update: update board set member_id = null where member_id = #{memberId}
